scope: Tokenizer-only regression diagnostic on twelve public fixtures known from v2; not independent language-coverage validation, LLM generation, payload or security evaluation
prior_design_information: Known v2 first-token29871 empty_extension refusals motivated this new method. Same fixtures are intentionally reused without claiming held-out evaluation.

adapter.special_token_ids: Every added_tokens row with special=true in the pinned tokenizer JSON

packet_policy.public_path_pool: Sorted unique union of singleton IDs0..258 inclusive, special IDs, and every nonempty contiguous token-ID span of length<=5 from encodings of ALL twelve predefined public fixture strings.
packet_policy.construction: At each canonical boundary, fixed lexicographic traversal of the complete public finite trie. Stop a branch on first accepted canonical endpoint, any forbidden-special endpoint, or terminal trie leaf. Expand other intermediate failures. All terminal frontier leaves, accepted and rejected, receive weight1.
packet_policy.node_budget_policy: Before any trie inspection, count all possible non-root trie nodes. If count>4096 refuse the entire fixture construction with no partial successful subset.
packet_policy.path_mass_outside_public_trie: Unknown; never interpreted as zero and never estimated as LLM mass.
packet_policy.boundary_gate: Full-prefix cumulative render must strictly append prior bytes, be strict UTF8, contain no output specials, and encode to exactly previousIDs+packet. Internal renders may be silent/noncanonical/incompleteUTF8; they are never transmitted.
packet_policy.segmentation: Require raw frontier tuples prefix-free including rejected/zero rows; receiver reconstructs full IDs from bytes then uniquely parses at boundary states.
packet_policy.weights: Artificial integer1 for every frontier leaf before admission; unchanged after admission; conditional denominator sum S.
packet_policy.empty_or_refused: Retain full case and stop at first reference-path refusal; no fallback, resampling, adding paths or raising limits.

receiver_contract: Received bytes and pinned public codec/provider/prompt/policy only, no sender path/trace. Token count from same public fixture plan allowed for this diagnostic, not a payload framing claim.
comparison: Fresh sender and receiver tokenizer objects; independently reconstruct provider at each boundary; all recorded construction inspections and packet admission summaries must agree. Same backend implementation is not independent tokenizer verification.
retention: All twelve cases including empty and every refusal; full source IDs, attempted packets, construction terminal/partial diagnostics, raw frontier denominator, receiver result and hashes. Separate nonempty denominator.
not_claimed: General recovery for all Unicode or all token paths
